howToBuy.title: HOW TO BUY
howToBuy.connectWalletDesc: Locate the presale widget at the top of the webpage ({link}) and click 'Connect Wallet' using your preferred wallet. Multiple wallet options (inc. Metamask and Coinbase) are available for selection.
howToBuy.selectTokenDesc: Choose your payment method (ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL, BNB, plus many more or pay by bank card), select the amount of $DOGEBALL you want and click the buy button. Enter any referral or bonus codes before purchase (see FAQs for details).
howToBuy.buyTokenDesc: Complete your purchase by approving the transaction in your connected wallet. Once confirmed, your purchase and token amount will be securely recorded on-chain and visible under 'Dashboard' in the presale widget above.
howToBuy.claimTokenDesc: After the presale ends, you can claim your $DOGEBALL tokens with the same wallet used for your purchase. Details on claiming will be released on social media channels once the presale concludes.
howToBuy.stakingDesc: Lock your presale purchase tokens in our secure and audited smart-contract staking pool; earn $DOGEBALL rewards with a high 80% APY and maximize your $DOGEBALL token return.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: $DOGEBALL is a dual-utility token powering a custom Layer 2 blockchain with near-zero fees, high speed, and strong security, seamlessly integrated into the $DOGEBALL online game. As the native token, it fuels the ecosystem and enables real-world utility, including future gaming-industry transactions.
faq.a2: Staking $DOGEBALL locks your tokens in a secure smart contract during the presale to earn extra $DOGEBALL at no cost. Rewards unlock after the 7-day minimum vesting period.
faq.a3: Join the $DOGEBALL community by connecting your wallet to the presale widget above {link} and paying with your preferred crypto or credit/debit card to secure your tokens.
faq.a4: Connect your wallet to see your $DOGEBALL token balance and purchase history in the Dashboard.
faq.q5: When do I receive my tokens?
faq.a5: After the presale, claim your $DOGEBALL using the same wallet used to purchase. Follow our social media for claim instructions and exchange listing dates.
faq.a6: Yes – the $DOGEBALL contract has been fully audited by Coinsult, a leading and trusted blockchain auditor, achieving a 100% audit score. This confirms the contract’s security and reliability. {link}
faq.q7: How do I generate a referral code and use bonus codes?
faq.a7: Generate your unique referral code via the Dashboard in the widget. Enter it in the Referral Code box before purchase; bonuses appear in the Dashboard. Limited-time codes go in Bonus Code box before purchase.

roadmapSteps.mainDescription: Step into the arena and show your aim! Tap or click to throw – time it right, and smash every target in your way!
roadmapSteps.description1: Each hit gives you points, and combos raise your score sky-high! But be careful – miss too many throws, and it's GAME OVER. Level up to unlock different backgrounds and arenas, all adding to the game experience.
roadmapSteps.description2: Enemies get faster and tougher, and get distanced as you level up. Only the sharpest and most accurate players can reach the TOP 10 Leaderboard, where the winner will receive the $500k jackpot of $DOGEBALL tokens, with another $500k prize pot split between the remaining 9 players. Note that only users who have purchased tokens in the $DOGEBALL presale are eligible to be part of the $1M PRIZE POT.

roadmapGame.title: Game Starts Soon !
roadmapGame.description: Available to play shortly after presale starts - keep an eye on the official Telegram and X social media channels for launch news
roadmapGame.privacyNote: Users must enter the same wallet address as they have used to make presale purchases on completion of the game (the option to enter wallet address will be displayed if the game score is high enough to land on the leaderboard). Note to protect user privacy and security, wallet addresses WILL NOT be visible on the website or mentioned in any social media channels; only the chosen username entered within the game itself will be mentioned.

ethL2.card5Text: Wait for the transaction to complete - the tokens will appear in your wallet on the DOGECHAIN network.
ethL2.card5Text2: See all transactions and blockchain activity for our DOGECHAIN {here}

ethL2.card7Text: And there you go, you have experienced the speed, zero-cost and security of the custom created DOGECHAIN ETH L2 Blockchain!
